additionalControls.name: Vision-LLM & Tabular Extraction Pipeline
additionalControls.purpose: Deterministic parser first; use Vision-LLM/document AI for complex CoAs, graphs and nested tables; output typed candidate JSON with original bytes, page rendering, coordinates and parser/model version. Unreadable/ambiguous/low confidence -> NEEDS_REVIEW/HOLD.
additionalControls.limitation: Typed parser and vision candidate gateway; live provider inference/answer key pending.

additionalControls.name: Deterministic Fallback & Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ)
additionalControls.purpose: Maximum 3 eligible idempotent retries with exponential backoff; noncritical draft/format/async tasks DLQ with run/revision/payload/reason/count; rule/manual verification for mandatory workflow while AI unavailable. No fabricated success or silent model substitution.
additionalControls.limitation: Persisted bounded retries, DLQ, explicit manual deterministic fallback; no fabricated success.

additionalControls.name: Data model / schema definition - MDM readiness
additionalControls.purpose: Product_ID, Batch_ID, Facility_ID, User_ID preserve local IDs and accept external_uuid, external_system, mapping_status (UNMAPPED/MATCHED/CONFLICT/RETIRED), mapping history/effective timestamps. Tenant/purpose/authorization before joins. Correlation key does not grant authority.
additionalControls.limitation: Identifier history and local/external mapping controls; correlation does not grant master-data authority.

additionalControls.name: Human Authority & Finalization - E-Signature Gateway
additionalControls.purpose: Password+OTP or approved biometric second factor; reason for signature; exact dossier/export revision and manifest hash; UTC signer audit. Material change needs re-review/re-sign; stale/hash mismatch/auth failure -> HOLD/REAUTHENTICATE/RE-REVIEW. Part 11 oriented control, not compliance certification.
additionalControls.limitation: Exact-revision platform identity plus enrolled TOTP technical signature; no Part 11 certification.
